claim: Declared concurrency capacity is bound to admitted evidence, not to a number. max_concurrency is uncapped; correctness is owned by the four N-independent invariants recorded here. Chef decision 2026-08-29: no numeric stop-loss, evidence ceiling instead.
non_claims: This records that each invariant was admitted, not that it will stay live, and not that resources suffice at any particular N.
This does not cap, recommend, or tune any concurrency value.
receipt.digest is a recorded provider fact, not a value any gate re-reads; the gate proves only that every named planted-negative test exists in the tracked suite.
known_residuals: The scheduler itself executes in the primary checkout rather than an isolated worktree; that seam is upstream Noodle territory tracked at ed3c/noodles#85 and none of I1-I4 covers it.
Software outside the admitted entrypoints can still edit the shared checkout; ed3c/noodles#46 declares this a non-claim, so I2 proves provenance only for work that entered through execute admission.

The I4 receipt is the pre-land candidate head, not a merge commit: ed3c/noodles#100 was authored stacked on ed3c/noodles#99 rather than after its land, so no merge SHA existed at write time. A landing-train rebase of that branch changes the head and no gate re-reads this field; the digest is N-class in both directions.
Every planted-negative name here is checked for existence, never for what it asserts. A test that was gutted but kept its name still satisfies this lock.

N-dependent behaviour - per-lane wall time, repair rate, provider throttling - is report-only in ./noodles metrics and is deliberately not a gate here; a lock that gated on it would be the numeric stop-loss this atom exists to refuse.

max_concurrency itself binds nothing operationally: it is read in exactly one place in the tracked tree (this gate, to decide whether the lock is required at all), and the number actually admitted per schedule cycle is max_useful_workers = len(components) in schedule_domain.schedule_decision, computed independently of .noodle.toml. Raising or lowering max_concurrency changes only whether this gate fires, never how many lanes noodles.py admits.
